fix:
Open toward 10.
(1) A listing shot under a hard back-left light, so the tops carry the sun's white glare and the prongs and pavé carry real sparkle. The 2-D options cannot do this as written. topspec and glint are inert, because their metal mask rejects the warm-graded metal (on 25,390 top px it exceeds 0.5 nowhere). A working-glint test (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-naira-scroll/81f6e48f-a340-5398-99b2-f7e22fb69d37/scratchpad/review6/var/v9_g40.png) read as stamped dots at 3.5×. Enable glints only with a warm-tolerant mask, a random amplitude and size per glint, and a visual check at 3× and 1:1.
(2) The notch: test each link point against each sweet's sphere in 3-D instead of reading the ground at the link's foot (untested). The two screen-space shortcuts tested in r4 (footocc, shcap) were rejected.
(3) Optional: glow=0.08 to fade the specks further (untested).
